recognize_zh: 視野中三顆中型不典型淋巴細胞，細胞核輪廓不規則、有凹陷或摺痕，染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡藍稀少；形態不具特異性，要靠 γδ T 細胞表型與脾腫大才能診斷肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Irregular nuclear contours with indentations and folds
Coarse, clumped chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Scant to moderate pale cytoplasm, focally with a few fine granules
Background red cells with echinocytes, occasional teardrop and fragmented forms; scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with crenated red cells and occasional teardrop forms. Three circulating atypical lymphoid cells are present, each medium in size with irregular, indented nuclear contours, coarse clumped chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a scant to moderate rim of pale cytoplasm with at most a few fine granules. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage. Together with splenomegaly and a gamma-delta T-cell phenotype on flow cytometry, findings are consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells have more abundant cytoplasm with coarse azurophilic granules and round nuclei, typically CD8+ alpha-beta, with an indolent course.
ANKL cells are EBV-positive NK cells with granular cytoplasm and a fulminant presentation, lacking surface CD3 and TCR gamma-delta.
Hairy cells have oval nuclei with circumferential hairy cytoplasmic projections and a CD11c/CD25/CD103 B-cell phenotype.
MCL cells are CD5+ B cells with cyclin D1, distinguishable from gamma-delta T cells by flow cytometry.
